sloka: यदा मे तनयः शस्तो लक्ष्मणेनेन्द्रजिद्युधि ।तदा ऽस्म्यभिहता तीव्रमद्य त्वस्मिन्निपातिता ।। ६.११४.५८ ।।
transliteration: yadā me tanayaḥ śasto lakṣmaṇenendrajidyudhi ।tadā 'smyabhihatā tīvramadya tvasminnipātitā ।। 6.114.58 ।।

translations.english: "O Lord of Rakshasas! Having slept on the best of beds, you are now lying here on the hard ground, body covered with dust. Where are you sleeping?"
